verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not show that MailerLite displays an individual subscriber's position inside an automation, or lets an ops user remove or re-enter that person mid-flow. The only related mention is that the CLI can manage automations generally (mailerlite-docs-10). That is an adjacent capability, not per-person automation state or controls.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can see where any individual person sits inside an automation and pull or re-enter them without breaking the flow
